finding: Big Five profiles relate differentially to positive mental health and psychopathology

finding: Life-satisfaction and trait changes are prospectively related across repeated assessments
what_future_liss_reanalysis_would_add: A harmonized repeated-wave plan can test temporal ordering and measurement equivalence
caution: Do not infer a universal direction from one SEM specification

finding: Traits predict wellbeing, strongest for affective components, in state-trait/RI-CLPM analyses
what_future_liss_reanalysis_would_add: A common-feature LISS package can separate affect overlap from appraisal and psychological/social outcomes

finding: MHC-SF emotional/psychological/social factors show reliability and a three-factor structure

finding: ESEM improves fit and lowers factor correlations versus CFA
